protocols.overview: Replication protocol for the Micro-Plasmoid Reversal system (PAPER_859). Primary element: Hydrogen (Z=1). Target temperature: 5000 K, magnetic field: 0.5 T, predicted COP: 1.5x. This protocol aims to verify UQFF SCm buoyancy signatures (1/r field decay, 1.2500 THz phonon resonance) and measure excess thermal power.
materials: High-purity Hydrogen (H, Z=1), ≥99.9%, 1–10 g
Reaction chamber (vacuum-rated or gas-tight as required)
Electrical feedthroughs rated for operating temperature
Cooling water supply (if electromagnet requires)
Calibration standards for all sensors
Lab notebook and camera for documentation

equipment.name: Data acquisition system
equipment.specification: 16-bit ADC, ≥1 kHz sampling, 8+ channels

equipment.name: Precision calorimeter
equipment.specification: Flow calorimeter or isoperibolic, ±0.1 W resolution
equipment.purpose: Measure input/output thermal power for COP determination

equipment.name: Permanent magnet array / small solenoid
equipment.specification: Field: 0.5 T, uniformity ±5% over reaction volume
equipment.purpose: Seed magnetic field for Birkeland current formation

equipment.name: Hall probe / fluxgate magnetometer
equipment.specification: Range: 0–1.0 T, resolution 0.001 T

equipment.name: Thermocouple array
equipment.specification: Type K (up to 1300 K) or Type R (up to 1700 K), ≥4 probes

equipment.name: THz spectrometer / Raman system
equipment.specification: Range covering 1.25 THz, resolution ≥1 GHz

equipment.name: Neutron detector
equipment.specification: He-3 proportional counter or BF3 tube, ±1 n/cm²/s sensitivity
equipment.purpose: Monitor neutron flux from reaction zone

equipment.name: Sample material (Hydrogen, Z=1)
equipment.specification: High purity (≥99.9%) Hydrogen (H) in appropriate form

safety.description: Operating temperature 5000 K — risk of severe burns
safety.mitigation: Heat-resistant gloves, face shield, ceramic containment vessel

safety.description: Moderate magnetic field (0.5 T)
safety.mitigation: Keep magnetic media and sensitive electronics >1m from apparatus

safety.description: Neutron density 1e+28 m⁻³ — activation and dose risk
safety.mitigation: Borated polyethylene shielding (min 10cm), personal dosimeter, real-time neutron monitor. Maximum 1 hour exposure per session.

safety.description: All LENR experiments must follow institutional radiation safety protocols
safety.mitigation: Review with radiation safety officer before first operation

procedure.action: Review safety notes and ensure all PPE is available. Verify radiation safety officer sign-off.
Calibrate all sensors: thermocouples, Hall probes, neutron detectors, DAQ.
Prepare sample material: Hydrogen (Z=1). Weigh to ±0.001 g. Record mass.
Energize magnetic field source. Ramp to 0.5 T over 60 seconds. Verify field uniformity at ±5% across reaction volume.
Position sample in reaction chamber. Seal chamber if gas-tight operation required.
Begin heating to target temperature 5000 K. Ramp rate: ≤50 K/min to avoid thermal shock.
Enable primary excitation source (RF/DC pulse, laser, or chemical trigger per system specification). Record exact trigger time.
procedure.notes: This is t=0 for the experiment

procedure.action:
Monitor and record all channels continuously:
  - Input power (electrical)
  - Output power (calorimetric)
  - Temperature at ≥4 points
  - Magnetic field
  - Neutron count rate
  - Phonon spectrum (THz/Raman if available)
procedure.notes: Minimum 30 min; extend if excess heat observed

procedure.action:
During active phase, perform 1/r field profile measurement:
  - Probe field at r = 1, 2, 5, 10 cm from reaction center
  - Record 3 measurements at each distance
  - Fit log(E) vs log(r) — expect slope = -1.00 ± 0.05
Check for phonon resonance at f = 1.2500e+12 Hz (1.2500 THz). Record peak frequency, width, and amplitude.
Disable excitation source. Allow system to cool to <350 K before opening.
Ramp magnetic field to zero. De-energize coils.
Retrieve sample. Weigh to ±0.001 g. Compare pre/post mass. If transmutation suspected, send for mass spectrometry analysis.
Export all DAQ data. Compute COP = P_out/P_in. Compare measured signatures against expected values in this protocol.

expected_signatures.name: 1/r field decay profile
expected_signatures.measurement_method: Multi-point field probe array at r = 1cm, 2cm, 5cm, 10cm

success_criteria: COP ≥ 0.8 (≥50% of predicted 1.5x)
Phonon peak within ±10% of 1.2500e+12 Hz
1/r field decay: power-law exponent = -1.00 ± 0.10
Magnetic confinement stable at 0.5 T ± 5% for ≥30 min
Neutron count rate elevated >3σ above background during active phase
All measurements repeated in ≥3 independent runs for statistical significance
references: PAPER_859 — Original UQFF whitepaper for this system
vds_dvp_bsh_lenr_synthesis.py — VDS/DVP/BSH calculator (parameter source)
CondensedPhysics.py — Primary UQFF calculator (tidal deformability, GW validation)
PAPER_001–009 — Core UQFF theory and gravitational wave framework
